原论文：[固定版本](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04362v1) · [[15_Disentangling Answer Engine Optimization from Platform Growth_ A Log-Based Natural Experiment on ChatGPT Referral Traffic.pdf|本地PDF]] # 把答案引擎优化效果与平台增长分开：基于ChatGPT引流日志的自然实验 **原题：**Disentangling Answer Engine Optimization from Platform Growth: A Log-Based Natural Experiment on ChatGPT Referral Traffic **作者：**Keisuke Watanabe、Kazuki Nakayashiki，Glasp Inc.；共同贡献、共同通讯作者，kei@glasp.co、kazuki@glasp.co。 **版本：**arXiv:2606.04362v1，2026年6月3日；首页日期2026年6月4日，9页。 **状态：**全文中文翻译与教学初校。正文1—10、附录A、1表4图、公式和6篇书目全部保留。未运行补充代码或复现实验。最保守检验p=.16，不能改写成“已确证AEO导致流量翻倍”。 ## 第一部分：全文中文译文 ### 摘要 ChatGPT等大语言模型“答案引擎”如今会向开放网络带来可测引荐流量，一种类似SEO的做法——本文称答案引擎优化AEO——随之出现。公开成功案例通常强调巨大的原始增长倍数，但这种增长混杂了答案引擎平台自身迅速增长。 本文报告一个高流量域名glasp.co的纵向现场研究：其中几十万篇YouTube问答页于2026年1月接受一套明确AEO干预，细节见第4节。干预集中于网站一部分，其余未处理页面提供同期对照，吸收平台顺风增长。使用第一方分析和服务器日志，而非第三方概率估计器，我们发现： 1. 原始增长主要受平台顺风推动：月聚合总ChatGPT引流增长5.7倍，同域未处理页面同期增长3.5倍。 2. 对每周处理/对照比率作中断时间序列，得到与干预对齐的离散水平提升×1.82，95%CI1.31—2.54，HAC p=.001；在参与会话过滤指标（×2.27）及替代规格下稳健。 3. 但保守时间安慰剂置换检验p=.16，干预前时间短且嘈杂，证据只是提示性，不是决定性。 4. 处理页面Google自然点击没有超出网站整体背景趋势的下降，索引收录保留，与SEO保护规则一致。 使用同域对照将处理效果与平台顺风分开，比某一个倍数更重要；头条式AEO增长倍数很可能夸大因果效果。 ### 1 引言 LLM答案引擎越来越介入用户如何抵达网页。ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Copilot回答时可能引用并链接来源，形成区别于经典网页搜索的引流渠道。实践者开始优化这一渠道，本文称AEO，与SEO及最近形式化的GEO[1]平行且部分重合。 公开案例往往只报一个惊人的增长倍数。倍数真实却难解释，因为同期答案引擎自身爆发增长；独立证据还显示AI回答界面改变开放网络点击行为[3]。核心问题不是“流量涨没涨”，而是**有多少归因于优化，有多少来自抬升各站的平台顺风**。 本文用单域名自然实验回答。可识别的YouTube问答语料接受干预，其他页面不处理。未处理组承受相同平台顺风、域名权威、分析与机器人过滤制度，因此可作为同期对照。 **贡献：** 1. 使用第一方服务器日志、网页分析而非第三方概率引用估计器的AEO测量法。 2. 使用同域对照扣除平台增长的自然实验，以ITS中断时间序列和时间安慰剂分析。 3. 保守、以区间报告的效果估计；作者认为这是诚实的AEO结果单位，优于混杂原始倍数。 4. 经验证的SEO安全机制，说明针对性改写不一定伤害既有自然搜索表现。 作者不声称随机化效果：干预是产品决策，不是随机试验，第7节完整报告有效性威胁。上述“经验证”是作者对该案例的表述，不能等同全站适用的安全保证。 ### 2 背景与相关工作 **GEO/AEO。**Aggarwal等[1]在受控合成基准中显示加入引用、统计、权威措辞可提升生成答案中的来源可见度。本文在方法上互补：不测合成生成可见度，而测真实网站随时间实现的下游引流。 **引擎引用行为。**Liu等[2]审计早期生成搜索引用召回、精确率，证明引用可测且不均。来源是否被引用（他们研究）与用户是否随后点击（本文研究），是同一链条中不同环节。 **AI回答与开放网络。**Pew[3]发现有AI摘要时用户点来源更少，说明实践者关心的终点是点击引流，不只是引用。 **方法。**识别借用Wagner等[4]分段回归ITS及双重差分DiD逻辑，同时遵守Bertrand等[6]关于序列相关会夸大显著性的提醒，使用HAC/Newey–West[5]标准误及时间安慰剂置换。 ### 3 场景与数据 **站点和语料。**glasp.co是社交网页高亮工具。研究语料在`/youtube/`路径下，为几十万篇YouTube问答页。它们是对公开视频作转换性问答总结，含创作者署名和嵌入视频，不是重发逐字稿。 **处理与对照。**AEO干预应用于`/youtube/`语料；同域其他长文、发现页、用户资料、reader等路径未接受干预，作为对照。两组共享域名、平台顺风、分析配置与机器人过滤制度。 **数据定义。**结果来自GA4 Data API：`sessionSource`含`chatgpt`的会话算ChatGPT引流，主要是chatgpt.com。同期其他AI引擎合计<1%的AI引流会话，排除。用落地页路径分处理/对照。报告原始sessions和GA4 engaged sessions，后者对非人类引荐噪声更稳健。Google自然点击、展示来自Search Console的`sc-domain:glasp.co`，页面包含`/youtube/`。 **精度。**GA4不同查询粒度因阈值和近似不完全可加。用每日提取重建月总量，与独立月查询比较，最大差3.3%。因此时序分析统一用每日派生系列，小于该水平差异视为噪声。2026年5月数据只到5月28日，是不完整月。 **保密和规模。**商业敏感流量仅报相对值：增长倍数、组比率、以2026年1月=100的指数；绝对会话、页面、展示数不公开。公共发布仅含指数聚合与代码。为说明统计量级：5月月度ChatGPT引流已达几十万次；处理语料几十万页；对照全窗口每周数千到数万会话，高于作者认为每周比率稳定所需水平。作者说这些估计（水平断点、平台因子、DiD、SEO比较）均尺度不变，隐藏绝对数不改变结果。 ### 4 干预：AEO处理包 2026年1月开始在`/youtube/`应用四项组合： 1. **URL规范化。**同内容的slug地址与视频ID地址合并为每视频一个规范URL。 2. **从机器人404日志挖需求。**把AI机器人访问不存在URL当需求信号，按最高频模式生成新页。 3. **标题和开头摘要改写。**标题变问句，TLDR变为可独立理解的2—3句回答，开头有描述性信息；按每页AI机器人请求量排优先级。 4. **SEO Guard保护。**在此前窗口获得有意义Google点击的页锁定，不改写；既无自然兴趣也无AI兴趣的页面取消发布；其余入改写队列。 四项同时实施，只估组合效果，不能分离单一战术边际贡献。404挖掘增加页面数，故效果混合每页改善与语料扩张。 ### 5 测量方法 **为何同域对照。**研究期ChatGPT引流在全网增长。只比较处理页前后无法分离顺风；同域未处理页暴露于相同顺风，差异增长用于隔离处理可归因部分。 **估计量。**令 (R(t)=treated(t)/control(t)\)。假设平台冲击对两组**相同且按乘法作用**，则log R不受此共同冲击影响。每周数据拟合： \[ \log R_t=\beta_0+\beta_1t+\beta_2D_t+\beta_3(t-t_0)D_t+\varepsilon_t.\tag{1} \] (D_t=1[t\ge t_0]\)，(t_0)取2026年1月首周。β1是原有趋势，exp(β2)是干预时立即发生的乘法水平变化，β3是斜率变化。HAC标准误用Newey–West、滞后4。前期为2025下半年，排除上半年是因ChatGPT引流尚小，比例被低计数噪声主导。 **推断保护。**前期短且自相关，额外使用：①移动块bootstrap的终态效果CI；②在前期每个候选日期重估β2的时间安慰剂置换，检验真实1月断点相对“假干预日”是否异常。 ### 6 结果 #### 6.1 原始倍数夸大效果 按最低日到峰值日看，2026年1月初低谷到5月5日峰值为38.2倍。这是脆弱估计：5月5日只是短峰，5月下旬持续水平不足峰值一半。改用月聚合总ChatGPT引流增长5.7倍，并将这种原始前后倍数仅作描述，不作因果。 #### 6.2 自然实验 处理窗口1月到5月，处理页增长6.1倍，对照因同样顺风增长3.5倍。简单DiD（这里用两增长倍数之比）为sessions×1.75、engaged sessions×2.48。 **表1：月ChatGPT引流会话。**每组分别将1月设100，绝对数不公开；R是底层绝对量的处理/对照比，不能用两个已经各自归一的指数直接相除当R。 |月|处理组指数|对照组指数|R| |---|---|---|---| |2025-07|46.5|227.4|.95| |2025-10|59.8|138.0|2.02| |2025-12|31.3|76.5|1.91| |2026-01|100.0|100.0|4.67| |2026-03|273.8|177.2|7.21| |2026-05|609.8|348.5|8.16| **图1：**处理（绿色`/youtube/*`）和对照（灰色其他页）月引流，各组1月=100，对数纵轴；红虚线为1月干预。两组都涨，但干预后处理组分离。原图未给所有月份精确值，仅保留曲线，不从像素补数。 ![[附件_15/原文第7页.png]] #### 6.3 中断时间序列 每周log R共47周：前26、后21。 - **前趋势β1：**+.027/周，乘×1.027，约每月+11%，p=.007。干预前处理语料已获得更高ChatGPT引流份额。 - **水平断点exp(β2)：**1.82，95%CI1.31—2.54，p=.001；与干预同步的显著离散跃升。 - **斜率变化β3：**p=.53，不显著；原趋势延续，作者解释干预改变水平而非斜率。 - **终态比率之比：**最后4后期周对前期均值为4.85倍，块bootstrap95%CI2.63—5.55；混合水平跃升和原趋势延续，不应当干预效果。 **图2：**蓝点每周log(处理/对照)，红线ITS拟合，水平灰虚线前期平均=.49，浅红阴影近似上线窗口2025年12月—2026年1月。断点β2约.60，指数化为1.82。日期不精确与方法中的t0近似一致。 ![[附件_15/原文第8页.png]] #### 6.4 安慰剂检验：提示性，不是定论 在前期每候选日期重估水平断点，安慰剂分布均值.24、最大绝对值.65，对照真实断点.60。置换p=.16。短且波动的前期本身会出现几乎一样大的假跃升，故虽HAC回归显著，最保守检验未越过传统阈值，作者将效果称“提示性”。 **图4：**灰直方图是前期假断点，红竖线真实1月=.60；横轴β2对数尺度，纵轴次数。真实点偏大，却未明显落到假断点分布之外，p=.16。 ![[附件_15/原文第9页.png]] #### 6.5 稳健性 水平跃升跨规格稳定：参与会话×2.27（p=.001），排除5月初峰值周×1.83（p=.001），前期改从2025年9月起×2.07（p=.0002）。均在1.8—2.3倍范围。 #### 6.6 SEO安全 处理页Google自然点击从2025下半年到2026年仅下降约25%，展示仍在正常范围，期末接近基线，作者据此称无取消索引。同期全站自然点击约降20%，处理页下降符合网站及行业背景，而非处理特有崩塌，与SEO Guard一致。 更强的“飞轮”（AEO引用可测地抬升自然搜索）没有证据：处理页自然流量持平到下降，没有上涨。 **图3：**处理页自然点击绿实线、展示橙虚线，各以2025年7月=100，红虚线干预日。点击温和下降，展示期末近基线。图3与图4同在第9页，保留整页原图。 #### 6.7 参与构成 ChatGPT引流参与率从1月.486升到5月.896，跃升集中于3月中旬机器人过滤政策改变。处理组上升比对照大，与更好内容—问题匹配及过滤造成的构成变化均一致；比率/DiD设计意在抵御共同部分影响。 ### 7 有效性威胁 1. **前趋势存在且显著。**log R在处理前已上升。ITS显式建模，安慰剂约束假跃升；如实报p=.16，不只看HAC p。 2. **SUTVA/溢出。**若AEO提高全域引用倾向，未处理页也受益，抬高对照，使DiD向下偏，此时效果偏保守。 3. **测量断点。**3月中旬过滤改变会话构成；用参与会话和共同冲击差分缓解。 4. **组合而非分项。**四战术相互混杂。 5. **单域单引擎。**一个站且ChatGPT主导，外部有效性未测试。 6. **内容异质。**处理/对照意图不同，没有匹配。 7. **观察性非随机、上线日不精确。**t0近似2026年1月。 ### 8 讨论 平台顺风大，必须扣除。此域名未优化页也涨3.5倍；天真处理页前后比较会把全部6.1倍都记优化。较可辩护的干预对齐水平效果约1.8—2.3倍，但最保守检验下仍只是提示性。作者怀疑很多公开AEO倍数也混淆处理和顺风，同域对照是低成本修正。其次AEO与SEO不必冲突：有保护的改写提高答案引擎引流，没有可测自然搜索伤害。 ### 9 局限与未来 第二轮改稿随机留出合格页子集，可将结构断点论证变成清晰实验效果，本文未做。匹配对照、多引擎多站复现、外部全平台引流指数，都能加强识别。 ### 10 结论 使用同域对照和第一方日志，在几十万页语料上分离AEO与平台增长。作者认为较可信的平台调整水平效果约1.8—2.3倍（提示性，安慰剂p=.16），自然搜索未见可测损害；与此同时平台顺风3.5倍主导原始增长。贡献是低成本、可复现的测量设计，作者主张报告AEO结果应以此为标准。 ### 附录 A 可复现性 月/周序列、分析脚本（OLS及手写Newey–West估计、ITS、安慰剂、稳健性）和作图脚本作为补充材料提供：`data/`、`stats.py`、`plot.py`。数据于2026年5月29日通过GA4 Data API和Search Console API查询。本PDF未列可直接点击的补充材料仓库地址，本稿未凭空补造或运行。 ### 参考文献（保留原始书目并加中文题名） 1. Bertrand, E. Duflo, S. Mullainathan. How Much Should We Trust Differences-in-Differences Estimates? *Quarterly Journal of Economics*, 119(1):249–275, 2004。中文：《我们应该多大程度相信双重差分估计？》。 ## 第二部分：小白逐步理解与实操 本节教学由译者编写；“青禾”案例和示范数字为虚构，没有访问你的后台或改动网站。 ### 1 先分清三层成绩：被引用、被点击、产生业务 某AI答案引用青禾官网，说明获得引用；用户点链接来到网站，才成为引流；最后下单/留资又是下一层。这篇测第二层的GA4会话，不测回答中的可见度，也没有报告销售增长。标题写“ChatGPT引流提高”，不能改成“品牌推荐率提高”或“转化翻倍”。 “平台顺风”像一条街游客突然变多。你家店顾客翻倍，隔壁没装修也翻倍，那么不能把全部增长归功于装修。ChatGPT用户与点击机会本身增加，同样会把许多网站一起抬高。 ### 2 用最简单数字拆开6.1倍 虚构处理页先100次、后610次，未改对照先100次、后350次。两组增长6.1、3.5倍。若相同平台冲击应使处理组也增长3.5倍，粗略净增长因子为： \[ \frac{610/100}{350/100}=\frac{6.1}{3.5}\approx1.74. \] 净因子1.74意味着相对该对照反事实约多74%，不是“净增长6.1−3.5=2.6倍”。本文精确月数据609.8/348.5≈1.75。 这仍不自动因果：如果处理页本来涨得更快，净因子也包含旧趋势。本文1月已经处理，1月→5月的1.75是处理窗口中的相对增长，不是干预发生前后完整效果。论文用2025下半年前期趋势与每周ITS进一步建模，得到另一个对象：干预时点的水平跳跃1.82。 ### 3 表1为什么两个100，R却是4.67？ 因为每组分别归一。演示：处理1月实际4670次，对照1000次，各自除以自己的1月值再×100，都是100；真实R=4670/1000=4.67。表中的指数用于各组纵向比较，不透露绝对量。 5月R约为4.67×609.8/348.5≈8.17，与原表8.16的差来自舍入。不要拿609.8/348.5=1.75去指责R列“算错了”；它是增长比，而R是量的比。 ### 4 ITS公式按一句话拆开 把每周处理/对照比率取自然对数，画成一条线。β0是起始水平，β1是上线前每周本来就会增加多少；D是上线开关，没上线0、上线后1；β2给开关打开时跳多高；β3说之后速度是否改变。 本文β1=.027，exp(.027)≈1.027，是每周多2.7%。β2≈.60，exp(.60)≈1.82，是水平高82%。β3 p=.53说明没有足够证据认为斜率改变，不能说已经证明斜率严格不变。 模型像把原来上坡的路整体抬高一截。最后一周相对很早之前涨4.85倍，既含坡路本来的上升，也含抬高，不能都算那一截。 为什么取log？共同乘法增长会被比率消去。例如平台都乘3，处理/对照=(3T)/(3C)=T/C；log方便将乘法效应写成加法回归。关键是两组受平台冲击的比例要相同，意图不同、受众不同可能违反它。同域只是改善可比性，不是保证。 ### 5 p=.001与p=.16并不互相打架 回归问：在指定趋势模型和误差处理下，这个断点与0的差是否很难用随机误差解释？HAC允许异方差与一定自相关，但仍依赖模型设定。 时间安慰剂换个问题：假装前期某天做过优化，模型会不会也经常找出大跳跃？本文历史波动能制造接近真实.60的假断点，p=.16。因此结果有希望，却不足最保守标准下定论。 p值不是“优化有效概率99.9%”，也不是“无效概率16%”。更稳妥写法：在该站观察到与干预对齐的1.8—2.3倍水平变化，不同回归规格一致，但时间安慰剂未显著，不能排除前期波动造成的解释。 ### 6 把四项干预变成可检查的动作 **URL规范化。**先列出同视频的slug页与ID页，核对内容是否真的重复，再确定一个规范URL，检查站内链接、站点地图与canonical信号是否一致。本文只说合并规范地址，没公开具体重定向规则；教学不把某一种实现冒充作者代码。更不能把不同内容的相似URL误合并。 Guard。**先识别已有自然流量的重要页面，避免把已有效的页全量改掉；保留旧版与回滚信息。论文没有给“有意义点击”的具体阈值、观察窗口长度或取消发布规则，因此不能替作者补成“30天零点击就删”。低流量可能是新页、季节性、跟踪故障；取消发布也可能损害站内连接，需按实际业务决策。 四项一起上时，未来只能说整套方案表现如何；若你想知道哪一项有效，应分批、随机留出或有计划地拆因素。论文没有证明“加两句话一定带来82%增长”。 ### 7 用现有后台建立低成本记录 先有已授权的GA4/GSC数据，不必为了读论文创建工具平台。把路径规则写成可复核说明，确保同一页始终分到同组，记录新页、合并页、取消发布页数量。 ```csv 数据填真实值，缺失留空并注明原因，不拿0充缺失。GA4来源字段统一口径，先用每日粒度抽取再聚合，不交替使用独立月总量。本文最大粒度差3.3%是该站测得，不是所有GA4站统一误差阈值；你的误差需要自己核对。 周序列画处理、对照、比率三张图；上线日、机器人过滤、埋点变化标在图上。本文3月过滤改变参与率，本身就提醒“流量质量提高”可能是分母被筛掉了。参与会话更稳健也不等于全是真人；两组受过滤影响不同，共同比率不能自动完全消除偏差。 5月仅到28日，和完整31日1月直接比较含天数差。复做可额外检查等长窗口或日均值，但明确这是自己的敏感性分析，不把论文原始5.7倍悄悄改为调整后数据。 ### 8 一个更强、仍可操作的实验 若有足够相似且合格页面，先按历史流量、主题、年龄分层，再在层内随机分一部分改稿、一部分保持。记录随机分配和实际执行，避免只把“看起来最有潜力”的页放处理组。观察期内尽量不对对照做同类改动，并记录共同营销活动。 上线前检查两组走势，预先定义主指标（例如ChatGPT引流会话）和SEO保护指标，不看到哪个涨才换主指标。保留整体效果，也单独看旧页与新页：扩充1000页带来更多总流量，不等于每页更强。 这只是设计建议，不声称本文做过随机试验。对小站的周流量若极少，T/C会被一个点击放大；应先报告小样本与零分母，不能照搬该站数千至数万对照周会话的稳定性判断。 ### 9 “SEO没受伤”应怎样准确表达？ 本文处理页点击约−25%，全站约−20%，绝对表现其实都下降。作者认为接近背景趋势，未发现处理特有崩塌；这与“证明零负面影响”不同。全站还包含处理页，并非完全独立SEO对照；差5个百分点是否有意义，需要样本、趋势和检验，而文稿没有给该差的CI。 展示保持基线说明仍有大量可见页面，不足以直接证明每个URL都保留索引。若实际运营关心收录，应加页面级索引检查，而不能只凭总展示量说所有页没掉索引。论文也明确没有观察到AEO带动SEO上涨的飞轮，不把“没明显伤害”包装成“SEO双赢”。 ### 10 学完后可以写出的诚实复盘 推荐表达模板：“在固定来源口径和窗口中，处理组引流增长A倍，同域对照增长B倍。粗略相对增长为A/B，干预前趋势为……；模型估计的水平变化及区间为……。机器人过滤/扩页/上线时间误差等影响已记录。结果属于观察性证据，尚不能拆出各战术效果。” 应避免：“从最差一天到最好一天38倍，所以AEO让流量暴涨38倍。”本论文专门反对这种峰谷选择。 Disentangling Answer Engine Optimization from
Platform Growth:
A Log-Based Natural Experiment on ChatGPT
Referral Traffic
Keisuke Watanabe∗1 and Kazuki Nakayashiki†1
1Glasp Inc.
June 4, 2026
Abstract
Large language model (LLM) “answer engines” such as ChatGPT now send measurable referral
traffic to the open web, and a practice analogous to search engine optimization, here called
Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), has emerged. Public AEO success stories typically quote
large raw growth multiples, but raw referral growth is confounded by the rapid platform-level
growth of the answer engines themselves.
We report a longitudinal field study on a single
high-traffic domain (glasp.co) whose corpus of hundreds of thousands of YouTube question-
and-answer pages received a defined bundle of AEO interventions in January 2026 (detailed in
Section 4). Because the interventions were concentrated on one subset of the site, the untreated
remainder of the same domain acts as a contemporaneous control that absorbs the platform
tailwind. Using first-party analytics and server logs rather than probabilistic third-party esti-
mators, we find: (1) raw growth is dominated by the platform tailwind: on monthly aggregates
total ChatGPT referrals grew 5.7× while untreated pages on the same domain grew 3.5× over
the same window; (2) an interrupted time-series model on the weekly treated/control ratio esti-
mates a discrete, intervention-aligned level increase of ×1.82 (95% CI 1.31–2.54, HAC p=0.001),
robust across engagement-filtered traffic (×2.27) and alternative specifications; (3) however, a
conservative placebo-in-time permutation test yields p=0.16, so the effect is suggestive, not con-
clusive, given a short and noisy pre-period; and (4) Google organic clicks to treated pages did
not fall beyond the ambient site-wide trend and indexation was preserved, consistent with the
SEO-protection rule. The methodological message, separating treatment from platform tailwind
with an on-domain control, matters more than any single multiple, and implies that headline
AEO multiples substantially overstate causal effect.
1
Introduction
LLM-based answer engines increasingly mediate how users reach web content. When ChatGPT,
Perplexity, Gemini, or Copilot answer a question, they may cite and link sources, producing a
referral channel distinct from classic web search.
Practitioners have begun optimizing content
for this channel, a practice we call Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), parallel to and partly

overlapping with search engine optimization (SEO) and the recently formalized notion of Generative
Engine Optimization [1].
Public AEO case studies typically report a single dramatic growth multiple. Such multiples
are real but difficult to interpret, because the answer engines themselves grew explosively over the
same window, and independent evidence shows AI answer surfaces are simultaneously reshaping
click behavior on the open web [3]. The central question is therefore not “did traffic grow,” but
how much of the growth is attributable to the optimization versus to the platform
tailwind that lifts all sites.
We answer this for a single domain using a natural experiment. The AEO interventions were
applied to one identifiable subset of the site (a corpus of YouTube question-and-answer pages),
while the rest of the same domain was left untreated. The untreated subset is exposed to the
identical platform tailwind, the same domain authority, and the same analytics and bot-filtering
regime, and therefore functions as a contemporaneous control.
Contributions.
1. A log-and-analytics measurement methodology for AEO that uses first-party server
logs and web analytics rather than probabilistic third-party citation estimators.
2. A natural-experiment design that nets out platform-level growth using an on-domain
control, analyzed with an interrupted time series (ITS) and a placebo-in-time test.
3. A conservative, range-reported effect estimate, which we argue is the honest unit of
an AEO result, in contrast to confounded raw multiples.
4. A validated SEO-safety mechanism showing that targeted rewriting need not damage
existing organic search performance.
We do not claim a randomized effect: the interventions were a product decision, not a randomized
trial, and we report the resulting threats to validity in full (Section 7).
2
Background and Related Work
Generative and Answer Engine Optimization.
Aggarwal et al. [1] introduced Generative
Engine Optimization and showed, in a controlled synthetic benchmark, that content modifications
(citations, statistics, authoritative phrasing) can raise a source’s visibility within generated answers.
Our work is complementary in method: rather than a synthetic benchmark of generation visibility,
we measure realized downstream referral traffic on a live domain over time.
Citation behavior of answer engines.
Liu et al. [2] audited citation recall and precision of early
generative search engines, establishing that what answer engines cite is measurable and uneven.
Whether a source is cited (their object of study) and whether users then click through (ours) are
distinct links in the same chain.
AI answer surfaces and the open web.
Pew Research Center [3] found that users click linked
sources far less often when an AI summary is present, motivating why click-through from answer
engines, not merely citation, is the quantity practitioners ultimately care about.

Methodology.
Our identification borrows the segmented-regression ITS framework of Wagner et
al. [4] and the difference-in-differences (DiD) logic, while heeding the warning of Bertrand et al. [6]
that serial correlation inflates significance in such designs. We therefore use HAC (Newey–West [5])
standard errors and a placebo-in-time permutation test.
3
Setting and Data
Site and corpus.
glasp.co is a social web highlighter.
The relevant corpus is hundreds of
thousands of YouTube question-and-answer pages under the path prefix /youtube/. These pages
present transformative question–answer summaries of public videos with creator attribution and
embedded video, not republished transcripts.
Treated vs. control.
The AEO interventions (Section 4) were applied to the /youtube/ corpus.
All other paths on the same domain (long-form articles, discovery pages, user profiles, reader)
received none of the interventions and constitute the control group. Both groups share the domain,
the platform tailwind, the analytics configuration, and the bot-filtering regime.
Data sources and definitions.
Outcomes are computed from the Google Analytics 4 Data API:
ChatGPT referrals are sessions whose sessionSource contains chatgpt (dominated by chatgpt.com;
other AI engines together contribute <1% of AI-referred sessions in the study window and are
excluded). The landing-page path splits treated vs. control. We report both raw sessions and
GA4 engaged sessions (the latter is more robust to non-human referral noise).
SEO outcomes
(clicks, impressions) come from Google Search Console (sc-domain:glasp.co) for pages contain-
ing /youtube/.
A note on data precision.
GA4 totals are not perfectly additive across query granularities
(thresholding/approximation). Rebuilding monthly totals from a daily pull and comparing against
an independent monthly query, we observe a maximum discrepancy of 3.3%. We therefore use the
daily-derived series as the single canonical source for the time-series analysis and treat differences
below this level as noise. All May 2026 figures are through 2026-05-28 (partial month).
Confidentiality and scale.
To protect commercially sensitive volumes, this paper reports all
quantities in relative form: growth multiples, group ratios, and series indexed to January 2026
(= 100). Absolute session, page, and impression counts are withheld; the accompanying public
release contains indexed aggregates and analysis code, not raw counts. To convey statistical power
without exact figures: total monthly ChatGPT referral sessions reached the hundreds of thousands
by May 2026, the treated corpus comprises hundreds of thousands of pages, and the control group
sustained on the order of thousands to tens of thousands of sessions per week throughout the win-
dow, comfortably above the level at which the weekly treated/control ratio is stable. Withholding
absolutes changes no result, because every estimate (the level break, the platform-tailwind factor,
the difference-in-differences, the SEO comparison) is scale-invariant.
4
Interventions: the AEO Treatment
The treatment is a bundle applied to the /youtube/ corpus starting in January 2026:
3

1. URL canonicalization. Duplicate URL patterns (slug-based and video-ID-based) serving
identical content were consolidated to one canonical URL per video.
2. Demand mining from bot 404 logs. AI-bot requests to non-existent URLs were treated
as demand signals; the highest-frequency patterns were used to generate new pages.
3. Title and lead-summary rewriting. Titles were converted to question form, and lead sum-
maries (TLDRs) were rewritten as standalone two-to-three-sentence answers with descriptive
openers, prioritized by AI-bot request volume per page.
4. SEO-protection rule (“SEO Guard”). Pages earning meaningful Google clicks in the
trailing window were locked from rewriting; pages with neither organic nor AI interest were
unpublished; the remainder entered the rewrite queue.
Because the bundle was applied together, we estimate its combined effect, not the marginal effect
of any single tactic. The treatment also changed corpus size (new pages from 404 mining), so the
estimated effect combines per-page improvement and corpus expansion.
5
Measurement Methodology
Why an on-domain control.
ChatGPT referral traffic grew across the entire web during the
study window. A before/after comparison on treated pages alone cannot separate treatment from
this tailwind. The untreated remainder of the same domain is exposed to the identical tailwind, so
the difference in growth isolates the treatment-attributable component.
Estimator.
Let R(t) = treated(t)/control(t). Under the assumption that platform shocks affect
both groups multiplicatively and equally, log R(t) is invariant to those shocks. On weekly data we
fit the segmented regression
log Rt = β0 + β1t + β2Dt + β3(t −t0)Dt + εt,
(1)
where Dt = 1[t ≥t0] and t0 is the first week of January 2026. Here β1 is the pre-existing trend,
exp(β2) is the immediate multiplicative level change at the intervention, and β3 is the change in
slope. Standard errors are HAC (Newey–West, lag 4). The pre-period is H2 2025 (the first half
of 2025 is excluded because ChatGPT referral volume was nascent and ratios are dominated by
small-count noise).
Inference safeguards.
Because the pre-period is short and autocorrelated, we complement the
regression with (i) a moving-block bootstrap CI for the end-state effect and (ii) a placebo-in-time
permutation test that re-estimates β2 at every candidate break inside the pre-period and asks how
unusual the observed January break is.

Results
6.1
The raw multiple overstates the effect
Read trough-to-peak, the daily series rises from its lowest day (early January 2026) to a single-day
peak (5 May 2026) by a factor of 38.2×. This is a fragile basis for an effect estimate: the May 5
value is a transient spike and the sustained late-May level is under half that peak. We therefore
report monthly aggregates instead, on which total ChatGPT referrals grew 5.7×, and treat such
raw before/after multiples as descriptive rather than causal.

6.3
Interrupted time series
On the weekly log R series (47 weeks; 26 pre, 21 post; Figure 2):
• Pre-trend β1: +0.027/week (×1.027, ≈+11%/month), p=0.007. The treated corpus was
already gaining ChatGPT-referral share before the intervention.
• Level break exp(β2) = 1.82 (95% CI 1.31–2.54), p=0.001: a significant discrete jump aligned
with the intervention.
• Slope change β3: p=0.53 (not significant). The pre-existing trend continued; the interven-
tion shifted the level, not the slope.
• End-state ratio-of-ratios (last 4 post weeks vs. pre-mean): 4.85× (block-bootstrap 95% CI
2.63–5.55). This conflates the level break with the continuation of the pre-existing trend and
should not be read as the intervention effect.
6.4
Placebo test: suggestive, not conclusive
Re-estimating the level break at every candidate date inside the pre-period yields a placebo dis-
tribution (Figure 4) with mean 0.24 and max | · | = 0.65 against an observed break of 0.60. The
permutation p-value is 0.16. The short, volatile pre-period can produce spurious jumps nearly as
large as the observed one, so although the regression effect is significant under HAC errors, the
most conservative test does not clear the conventional threshold. We therefore characterize the
effect as suggestive.
6.5
Robustness
The level break is stable across specifications: engaged sessions ×2.27 (p=0.001); excluding the
early-May spike weeks ×1.83 (p=0.001); and an alternative pre-window starting 2025-09 ×2.07
(p=0.0002). All estimates sit in the 1.8–2.3× range.
5

6.6
SEO safety
Google organic clicks to treated /youtube/ pages fell only ≈25% from their H2 2025 level to
2026, while impressions stayed within their normal range and ended the window near baseline (no
deindexation; Figure 3). Site-wide organic clicks fell ≈20% over the same window. The treated-
page decline is in line with the ambient site-wide and industry trend rather than a treatment-specific
collapse, consistent with the SEO-protection rule. We find no support for the stronger “flywheel”
claim (that AEO citations measurably lifted organic search) in this window: treated organic was
flat-to-declining, not rising.
6.7
Engagement composition
ChatGPT-referral engagement rate rose from 0.486 (Jan) to 0.896 (May), with the jump con-
centrated at a mid-March bot-filtering policy change. The increase was larger for treated pages
than control, consistent with both better content–query matching and a composition change from
filtering; the ratio/DiD design is intended to be robust to the common component.
7
Threats to Validity
1. Pre-trend present and significant. log R drifts upward before treatment. Mitigation: the
ITS explicitly models the pre-trend and the placebo test bounds spurious breaks; we report
the placebo p=0.16 honestly rather than relying on the HAC p alone.
2. SUTVA / spillover. If AEO raised domain-level citation propensity, untreated pages also
benefited, inflating the control and biasing DiD downward; reported effects are then conser-
vative.
3. Measurement discontinuity. The mid-March bot-filtering change altered session compo-
sition. Mitigation: engaged-session outcome and common-shock differencing.
4. Bundle, not component. The four tactics are confounded with one another.
5. Single domain, single engine. One site, ChatGPT-dominant; external validity untested.
6. Content heterogeneity between groups. Treated and control differ in intent and are not
matched.
7. Observational, non-randomized; imprecise rollout date (t0 approximated as January
2026).
8
Discussion
The practical lesson is that the platform tailwind is large and must be netted out. On this
domain, untreated pages grew 3.5× with no optimization at all; a naive before/after on treated
pages would credit the full 6.1× to the optimization. The defensible, intervention-aligned level
effect is ∼1.8–2.3×, and even that is only suggestive under the most conservative test. We suspect
many published AEO multiples are similarly inflated by conflating treatment with tailwind, and
that on-domain controls are the lowest-cost available correction. A secondary lesson is that AEO
and SEO need not be in tension: a guarded rewrite program improved answer-engine referrals
without measurable organic harm.

9
Limitations and Future Work
A randomized second-pass rewrite (holding out a random subset of eligible pages) would convert
the structural-break argument into a clean experimental effect; we did not run one here. Matched
controls, multi-engine and multi-domain replication, and an external platform-wide referral index
would each strengthen identification.
10
Conclusion
Using an on-domain control and first-party logs, we separate AEO treatment effect from platform
growth on a large corpus (hundreds of thousands of pages). The credible, platform-adjusted level
effect is ∼1.8–2.3× (suggestive, pplacebo=0.16), achieved without measurable damage to organic
search, against a 3.5× platform tailwind that dominates the raw numbers. The contribution is
a low-cost, reproducible measurement design that we believe should be standard when reporting
AEO results.
A
Reproducibility
The monthly and weekly series, the analysis script (OLS with a hand-implemented Newey–West
estimator, the ITS model, the placebo test, and robustness checks), and the plotting script are
provided as supplementary material (data/, stats.py, plot.py). Data were queried from the
GA4 Data API and the Search Console API on 2026-05-29.
